title: Family Tree Vocabulary
description: Identify family members, kinship relationships, and describe immediate and extended family ties.
objectives: Name immediate family members (parents, mother, father, siblings, brother, sister, children, son, daughter)
Name extended family members (grandparents, uncle, aunt, cousins)
Introduce and describe your family members using simple present sentences

vocabularyList.exampleSentence: My mother is a caring teacher.
His father works at a government office.

vocabularyList.definition: A man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.
vocabularyList.exampleSentence: I have an elder brother in Lahore.

vocabularyList.definition: A woman or girl in relation to other daughters and sons of her parents.
A young person; son or daughter.
vocabularyList.exampleSentence: Every child deserves a good education.

vocabularyList.definition: The brother of one's father or mother or the husband of one's aunt.
vocabularyList.exampleSentence: My uncle Tariq visited us yesterday.

vocabularyList.definition: The sister of one's father or mother or the wife of one's uncle.
vocabularyList.exampleSentence: Her aunt lives in the UK.

sections.title: Immediate & Extended Family Structure
sections.content:
In English, family terminology is grouped into two main circles:

### 1. Immediate Family
- **Parents**: Mother + Father
- **Children**: Son (boy) + Daughter (girl)
- **Siblings**: Brothers + Sisters
- **Spouses**: Husband (male) + Wife (female)

### 2. Extended Family
- **Grandparents**: Grandfather + Grandmother
- **Grandchildren**: Grandson + Granddaughter
- **Parents' Siblings**: Uncle (male) + Aunt (female)
- **Uncle/Aunt's Children**: Cousins (male or female)

sections.title: Lesson Summary
summaryPoints: Uncle = any brother of father/mother; Aunt = any sister of father/mother.
Cousin = child of uncle or aunt (never say 'cousin brother/sister').
